claim: The leading GTEx v11 fibroblast PMP22 cis-eQTL direction transfers to independent GENCORD fibroblasts.
context: GTEx adult cultured fibroblasts versus GENCORD fibroblasts; population allele-dose association with normalized mature gene RNA, not Schwann-cell or promoter-specific regulation.
baseline_model: No directionally concordant association at the exact discovery lead in the independent cohort. A different gene-level locus is not automatic replication.
validation_sources: eQTL Catalogue release7 QTS000012 GENCORD, QTD000100 gene expression; https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/spot/eQTL/sumstats/QTS000012/QTD000100/QTD000100.all.tsv.gz
prior_exposure: GTEx v8 and v11 discovery summaries inspected; GENCORD design metadata, release7 file listing and methods inspected only. No GENCORD PMP22 result table or outcome has been read. Existing human TATA/UTR experiments and rat promoter responses are already known. This is prospective relative to this session's independent-cohort outcome inspection, not a claim that no prior literature/model knowledge exists.
prediction: Exact chr17_15314994_A_G (rs2531950), GRCh38, ALT G relative to REF A, positive beta for ENSG00000109099 gene expression in GENCORD fibroblasts.
analysis_plan: Validate literal chromosome/position/REF/ALT and gene identity before lookup. Retain all PMP22 gene-level variants and full gene-level permutation row to audit feature coverage and locus alternatives. Deduplicate identical rsID aliases only after confirming all non-rsID fields equal. Source release7 metadata supplies 186 fibroblast samples; verify allele numbers per variant and QC/cohort details. Use published beta, se, two-sided nominal p-value; compute approximate normal 95% intervals beta +/-1.96*se, not re-fit data. No pooled meta-analysis with GTEx because normalization/context differ. Preserve source missingness and every failed condition.
success_rule: The exact primary variant is eligible, beta > 0, and source two-sided p < 0.05. This supports directional association transfer at this preselected locus only; it does not demonstrate causality, matched effect magnitude or nerve specificity.
failure_rule: An eligible negative beta with p < 0.05 contradicts the directional transfer. Otherwise a tested non-significant primary result is non-replication with uncertainty, not equivalence or proof of no effect. Missing variant, gene, incompatible allele or failed quantification makes the test untestable; do not substitute the best available SNP.
confounder_checks: Independent GENCORD cohort versus GTEx; no GTEx reanalysis counted as replication
Exact same effect allele and assembly; no silent strand flips for palindromic sites
Gene expression versus first-exon/isoform endpoint distinction
Different age/tissue origin/culture and normalization; population LD and cell-state alternatives
Variant allele count and imputation status where supplied
selection_and_multiplicity: One confirmatory transfer: v11 strongest fibroblast lead, chosen because fibroblasts are informative and independent GENCORD measurements exist. Primary alpha .05 two-sided plus positive direction. Earlier v8 lead rs6502441 and other SNPs are descriptive exploratory context, not rescue of a failed primary test. GTEx cross-tissue scan is exploratory; source q-values are tissue-specific, not an extra across-tissue family correction.
